# SolidMix RMC

> SolidMix RMC is a ready mix concrete (RMC) supplier based in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India, supplying precision-mixed concrete across Raipur and Chhattisgarh since 2023 from its plant at Serikhedi, near Rawabhata.

## Who we are

SolidMix RMC operates a modern RMC plant and concrete batching plant using computer-controlled mixing technology, delivering consistent, high-strength ready mix concrete for residential, commercial and infrastructure projects.

- Plant address: PH No. 77, Khasra No. 365/5, Serikhedi, Raipur, Chhattisgarh – 492101
- Office address: Office no. 418, 4th floor, Lalganga Business Park, Pachpedi Naka, Raipur, C.G. 492001
- Phone: +91 9893111201, +91 9111109642
- Email: info@solidmixrmc.com, support@solidmixrmc.com
- Hours: Open 24×7, every day

## Concrete grades

We supply M20, M25, M30, M35, and M40 grade ready mix concrete. A free consultation is available to help choose the right grade for a project.

## Minimum order and delivery

- Minimum order: 6 cubic meters (one transit mixer load)
- Delivery time: 60–90 minutes after order confirmation for most Raipur city areas (delivery time may vary for distant locations)

## Service areas

Raipur city: Kota, Tatibandh, Sarona, Pandri, Raipur Railway Station, Gudhiyari, Bhatagaon, Telibandha, Mowa, Urla Industrial Area, Bhanpuri.

Nearby outskirts: Birgaon, Swami Vivekananda Airport, Dharsiwa, Siltara Industrial Area, Kandul.

Naya Raipur side: Nandanvan Jungle Safari, Mandir Hasaud, Naya Raipur (Atal Nagar), Mana.

Towards Bhilai / Durg: Kumhari, Charoda, Bhilai, Durg.

Towards Bilaspur / Baloda Bazar road: Tilda-Neora, Neora.

Towards Mahasamund / Odisha road: Arang, Abhanpur.

Beyond 40 km: Dhamtari, Simga, Kurud, Baloda Bazar, Mahasamund.

Additional areas: Bemetara, Tilda, Tarpongi, Berla.
